<when condition="@{
      var client = (string)context.Variables["aipClientId"];
      var clients = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aipClients", "").Split(',');
      return string.IsNullOrEmpty(client) || !clients.Contains(client);
    }">
      
        
        
          application/json
        
        {"code":"client-not-granted"}
      
    
  
  <set-variable name="aipWindow" value="@{
    var client = (string)context.Variables["aipClientId"];
    var now = context.Timestamp;
    foreach (var entry in context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aipAccess", "").Split(';')) {
      var parts = entry.Split('|');
      if (parts.Length != 4 || parts[0] != client) { continue; }
      if (parts[1] != "active") { return "grant-suspended"; }
      if (DateTimeOffset.Parse(parts[2]) > now) { return "grant-suspended"; }
      if (parts[3] == "untilRevoked") { return "ok"; }
      if (now >= DateTimeOffset.Parse(parts[3])) { return "grant-expired"; }
      return "ok";
    }
    return "grant-suspended";
  }" />
  
    
      
        
          
            
            
              application/json
            
            @("{\"code\":\"" + (string)context.Variables["aipWindow"] + "\"}")
